title: Act: Create encodePng and readPngSize in the frontend lib
summary: Add pngEncode.ts with deterministic PNG encoding
description: Create game/frontend/src/lib/pngEncode.ts exporting encodePng and readPngSize using node:zlib deflateSync at fixed level 9.
acceptance_criteria: encodePng returns equal bytes on repeated calls
readPngSize returns the encoded width and height

steps.action: Add a module-level 256-entry CRC table, crc32(bytes) and chunk(type, data) returning length(4 BE)+type+data+crc over type+data.

Export encodePng(img: RgbaImage): Uint8Array that writes the 8-byte signature, IHDR (width, height, bit depth 8, colour type 6, 0,0,0), one IDAT of deflateSync of rows each prefixed by filter byte 0 with level 9, then IEND; no other chunks.
Export readPngSize(bytes) returning {width,height} read big-endian from offsets 16 and 20; throw Error('not a png') when the signature differs.
